title: Malawach
description: A traditional dish from Israel, centered on all-purpose flour. A measured home-kitchen version organized by cooking step.

steps.instruction: Mix the dough ingredients, knead until smooth and elastic, then cover and rest for about 15 minutes.
Roll or press the prepared dough evenly into the desired thickness and shape.
Cool the prepared ingredients promptly, then refrigerate for about 40 minutes until properly chilled.
Heat the pan over medium heat, shape or spoon out portions, and fry for about 18 minutes total until golden on both sides and fully cooked.
